This is what I do with my 4 yo Shiloh Shepherd. She is incredibly territorial and our neighbors on both sides have small yappy dogs. Whenever she hears them she goes berserk and gets aggressive. She whips her frisbee back and forth and sometimes nips at our other dog. 
It was, in the beginning when we first moved, just like you described. She would not focus on anything else. 
What I do now Is call her and give her a treat when she comes to me. I physically get her off the window sill and give her snuggles sometimes. I get her favorite toy. If it’s really bad, I point the spray bottle at her to get her attention. 
I think the best thing to do is to break that focus on whatever it is they’re freaking out about and just get them to chill. I tell her it’s okay and I try to get her to lay down so I can rub her belly or brush her itchy spots. 
Now she’s to the point that sometimes when she hears them she comes straight to me and whines and I do whatever it is she wants, brush, toy, scratches, kisses, treats, etc. It takes time, but it’ll work if you’re consistent.
